company.description: WNNA is an Intuitive based personal recommendation engine that is empowered by AI. WNNA app recommends activities you could do based on decisions you would usually make. Activities may include listening to music, watching movies, eating food, visiting attractions and so on. It does this by scurrying through different sources over the internet, get you only the information you would regularly use to make decisions

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $340,955 to $852,472, a 2.5x increase.
